name: Zvorotnij Gals
source:
Eternity, love, freedom – how do they connect? Tom Warren’s story reveals a deep, passionate love and hope in the dark.

[From [url=https://blindshen14.itch.io/back-tack]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
永恒、爱、自由，三者如何相连？汤姆·沃伦的故事，在黑暗中展现了深切而炽热的爱与希望。

［摘自[url=https://blindshen14.itch.io/back-tack]itch.io[/url]］
